ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the mission planning report was ingested by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder or interface path from which the source report was collected

satellite_id.description: Satellite identifier from the SatelliteID column

datatake_id.description: Datatake identifier from DatatakeId (S1) or ID/AcquisitionID (S2)

observation_time_start.description: Observation start time from the ObservationTimeStart column

observation_time_stop.description: Observation stop time from the ObservationTimeStop column (S2)

observation_duration.description: Observation duration in milliseconds from the ObservationDuration [msec] column

l0_sensing_time_start.description: Level-0 sensing start time from the L0SensingTimeStart column (S1)

l0_sensing_duration.description: Level-0 sensing duration in milliseconds from the L0SensingDuration [msec] column (S1)

number_of_scenes.description: Number of scenes from the NumberOfScenes column (S2)

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number from the AbsoluteOrbit column

relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number from the RelativeOrbit column

polarization.description: Acquisition polarization from the Polarization column (S1)

instrument_mode.description: Instrument acquisition mode from the InstrumentMode column

instrument_swath.description: Instrument swath from the InstrumentSwath column (S1)

timeliness.description: Timeliness category from the Timeliness column

interface_name.description: Collector interface name set to S1MissionPlanning or S2MissionPlanning

production_service_type.description: Production service type set by the collector to AUXIP

production_service_name.description: Production service name set by the collector to CGS
